next.reason: 1985: "The last statement in a declarative section when the statement is in the range of an active PERFORM statement executed in a different section"; 2023: "In the declarative section for a fatal exception condition, there is no next executable statement after ... the run unit is terminated abnormally". 2023 keeps the no-next-statement case only for fatal-exception declaratives, and now terminates the run unit abnormally, with implementor exceptions for SORT, MERGE and I-O.
